_comment: Written before any code, per AGENTS.md rule 4. Each backend agent module must load the prompt file named here at runtime. Update as the build names new pieces.
_due_note: Extended one week by Prof. Zaman; reported by Christine 2026-11-07. The requirements page still shows 2026-11-16. Confirm on Canvas.
_agent_roster_note: Revised 2026-11-07. Narrative and Evidence were split (extraction is a different job from mapping), Pattern became Reasoning (interrogation + cross-criterion trade-offs), and Safety became a peer that runs alongside Narrative rather than a filter after it. Criteria is off the brain-dump path: it serves the Criteria screen and Checklist Mode.
_ab_note: backend/evals/ab.py is the A/B comparison against the status quo: a general-purpose chatbot on the same model, same entries. Its prompt is declared here like any agent's because it is graded work, not a test fixture — the rubric's Tier 3 bar asks for a measured comparison against how the task is done today. The prompt is deliberately a GOOD generic prompt; a strawman baseline would make the comparison worthless.
_evidence_note: The eval and A/B artefacts are written by `python -m backend.run_evals`. A demo-mode run produces them for free but stamps every page 'NOT EVIDENCE' — only `--mode live` output may be quoted in report.html or slides.html.
